name: glitch-pets
description: Glitch pets: pick one of six pixel critters; it sits at the end of the HUD row, shows moods and says a word now and then; leads the crew pane when Claude splits work across a crew of agents.

voiceEveryMinutes.title: Minutes between remarks
voiceEveryMinutes.description: At most one remark per this many minutes

tiredMinutes.title: Tired after (minutes)
tiredMinutes.description: A turn this long makes the pet tired

sleepyMinutes.title: Sleepy after (minutes)
sleepyMinutes.description: This long without a prompt makes the pet sleepy

crewPane.title: Crew pane
crewPane.description: auto: open when a crew starts; manual: only from the HUD crew pill or /glitch crew

crewReview.title: Crew review gate
crewReview.description: The crew rule in the system prompt, and a reminder when 2+ crew members finished without a reviewer

crewTiers.title: Crew tiers
crewTiers.description: JSON: the model and effort each crew member of a tier runs at (low, medium or high), e.g. {"light":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","effort":"low"}}, plus a reviewer entry for the crew reviewer; empty: Haiku low, Sonnet medium, Opus high, reviewer Sonnet low

crewTheme.title: Crew look
crewTheme.description: How crew members look in the crew pane; /glitch crew theme <id> overrides it
